runtimes.value: Ollama official qwen3.6:35b-a3b (broken tool calls give HTTP 500, #16383 open); llama.cpp llama-server with GGUF + vision mmproj (ggml-org, also MTP GGUF); LM Studio (lmstudio-community GGUF and MLX 4/6/8-bit); mlx-lm/mlx-vlm with mlx-community builds (4-8 bit, bf16, mxfp4/8, nvfp4, DWQ, MTP)
runtimes.note: Ollama issue status from an earlier check (13.11.2026), not re-checked. Which MLX package handles vision for the mlx-community builds not confirmed.

web.scope: Searched on 13.11.2026. Sources: Hacker News comments, Hugging Face discussions, Ollama, llama.cpp and mlx-lm issues. **Reddit could not be read** (blocked for automated reading); summaries of Reddit threads by other sites were not used as evidence. Released 15.04.2026; window: since 13.05.2026 plus the launch discussion.
web.summary: Fast everyday model, Haiku level, good vision; weak for agentic coding. No comment on French or German. Users wait for a Qwen3.8 version of the 35B-A3B ([ch_sm, 04.11.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50370244)).
web.verdict: Fast everyday model (Haiku level), good vision; weak for agentic coding, tool-call errors

comments.text: Not really useful as a coding model; Qwen3.8 27B is the minimum for that ([ekidd, 03.10.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49944552)).

Tool mistakes in agents: edits files in the wrong folders ([tripzilch, 23.09.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49815895)); failed often enough in OpenClaw to be unusable ([sweetjuly, 21.10.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50188449)).
Less precise than Gemma 4 26B for structured extraction: more creative and verbose, less exact ([zkmon, 30.04.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=47962051)).
Ollama: broken tool calls give HTTP 500, bug open ([ollama#16383, 01.06.2026](https://github.com/ollama/ollama/issues/16383)).
Both much faster and much more capable than Haiku, used every day ([sznio, 24.09.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49837523)).
About 90 tok/s on an M3 Max (Q6, MLX) ([seanmcdirmid, 14.09.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49690588)).

Everyday writing: e-mails, messages, tickets ([LeBit, 24.09.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49836240)); good for coding and translations ([embedding-shape, 20.05.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=48206909)).

Vision much better than gemma4-26b-a4b ([jwr, 18.05.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=48182721)); OCR of faded and handwritten receipts ([nullc, 29.06.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=48717401)).
